name: proofbundle
description: Signed, Merkle-committed provenance envelope for any digital artifact — offline, single-file, no trust required.

scripts.test:crypto: cd crypto && node t_keccak.mjs && node t_mlkem.mjs && node t_ref.mjs && node t_confidential.mjs
